citation: Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al., Nature 2026

escape.note: Looming visual projection (LPLC2, LC4, LPLC1) onto giant-fibre / escape DNs and jump/wing-power motors. Motor firing is Δrate, not flight.

sugar.note: Labellum sugar GRNs (Gr5a/Gr64f annotations) onto proboscis/pharynx motor neurons.

bitter.note: Labellum bitter GRNs (Gr33a) onto the same feeding motors. Expected suppression, not invented IDs.

fermentation.note: Antennal ORNs of food/fruit glomeruli DM1, VA2, DM2, VM2. Not a validated fermentation circuit.

mechano.note: Johnston organ A and front-leg club chordotonal neurons. Used for ponte/cantieri/treni only as mechanosensory stand-in.

limitations: Anatomical model, not physiology. Shiu 2024 LIF constants on a BANC edgelist are not a validated BANC simulation.
Motor Δrate is not walking, flying, government, or endorsement.
